## Abstract solution

```{r}

# 1. create a chunck (or function) that reads one trip file (one that passed validation): 
  # a - check if all ids are unique
  # b - store result in a dataframe (logs), something like: filename: x; rule_name: check_unique, status: y, errors (any addional info that can help us understand why it failed, if failed)

# define path
trip_file = "ph_files/trip_ll_ph_2024.csv"
activity_file = "ph_files/activity_ll_ph_2024.csv"
catch_file = "ph_files/catch_ll_ph_2024.csv"

# read from path
trip_df = read.csv(trip_file)
activity_df = read.csv(activity_file)
catch_df = read.csv(catch_file)

# First check: ids are unique
diff_rows <- nrow(trip_df) - nrow(trip_df |> distinct(trip_id))

logs <- data.frame()
if (diff_rows != 0){
  
  logs_details <- trip_df |>
    group_by(trip_id) |>
    summarise(n = n()) |>
    filter(n > 1)
  
  df <- data.frame(rule_name = "unique ids", 
                   filename = trip_file,
                   status = "failed", 
                   error_details = logs_details |> pull(trip_id))
  
  logs <- bind_rows(logs, df)
  print("ids are not unique")
}else{
  
   df <- data.frame(rule_name = "unique ids", 
                   filename = trip_file,
                   status = "passed", 
                   error_details = NA)
  
  logs <- bind_rows(logs, df)
  
  print("ids are all unique")
}

```
